d: India, China, Russia and Iran have come together at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. In this video, Firstpost explains the SCO’s role, its 25-year history and the key issues discussed, including security, terrorism, trade, connectivity, energy and digital cooperation. The video also covers Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s meetings with Russian President Vladimir Putin, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, alongside developments in India-China ties and the conflicts in Ukraine and…
